generator_metadata.summary: 0-bg grid (h~6-8, w~6-8) with 2-4 SPARSE SEED cells placed at random positions, each in a distinct non-bg color (the seed colors are simply 2, 3, 4, 5 in placement order). Rule: for each non-bg seed cell at (r, c), STAMP a 5-cell PLUS shape in color 8 (cyan): the center (r, c) and the four cardinal neighbors (r-1, c), (r+1, c), (r, c-1), (r, c+1). Cells that fall outside the grid are clipped. The seed cells themselves are OVERPAINTED to color 8 (their original color is replaced). Net: every colored seed dot becomes a cyan plus-sign on a black field; the original seed colors disappear.
